profile.summaryJa: 人々はバアルの神殿を壊し、祭壇の前で祭司マタンを殺しました。
profile.identityNoteJa: この節に登場する祭司マタンです。

wikipedia.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, L–Z
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版の人物一覧は、列王記下11:18で殺されたバアルの祭司マタンを挙げています。
wikipedia.verifiedHeadingOrText: The Mattan entry identifies the priest of Baal killed in the uprising and cites 2 Kings 11:18. Its separate royal-family clause is unreliable and not adopted.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over the LORD’s house.
